utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — what time should I plan on being ready for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s say 7:30 sharp, and I’ll swing by right after that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll be ready at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I’m good for the carpool—what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s do 7:15 — I’ll swing by a few minutes after.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll be ready around 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the carpool is still on for tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on for tomorrow — I just want to make sure we’ve got the timing and pickup spot sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so what time and pickup spot did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the carpool. I’m still a little fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help figure it out with you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got the list started, and we can sort the seats and pickup times together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect—thanks, Cleo. Just point me to the list, and I’ll do my best to keep the pickups straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to make sure I’ve got it right—what time is the carpool, and who’s riding with us?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s around 8, and it’s just the usual group—me and the kids, I believe.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll treat it as around 8 with you and the kids unless you confirm otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — did I miss the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — you didn’t miss it. We’re just figuring out pickup times and who’s driving first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good timing then — I can take the first drive if that helps, and I’m flexible on pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could we aim for 7:30 tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me — I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the carpool spots and times for us—just tell me where we’re meeting and who’s riding with us.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let’s meet at the school front loop, and it’ll be me, Ben, and Maya riding with us.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — school front loop, with you, Ben, and Maya. I’ll keep that noted and track the carpool spot for us.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I just heard the carpool might shift by a few minutes this week. Want me to keep an ear out and let you know if it changes again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please — that’d be great. If you hear anything, send it my way and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow? If so, what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, we’re still on. Be ready around 8:15 and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll be ready at 8:15. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep the carpool plan in mind and pass it along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that. I’m still catching up, so just let me know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll let you know if the carpool changes and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help coordinate the carpool. Who’s riding with whom, and what time do we need to leave?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. If you could take Mia and Ben, I can drive the others — we should leave around 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll take Mia and Ben, and we’ll be ready to leave by 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, for sure — I can pass along the carpool details. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Let’s say 7:30 in the morning works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: 7:30 works for me too — I’ll let everyone know. If anything changes, I’ll send an update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — are we still good for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we’re still good — I’ll repeat the plan so we’re on the same page. I’ll pick you up at the usual spot in about ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks — I’ll be ready at the usual spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the carpool — what time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Around 7:30 works best for me if that’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me too — I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the carpool—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — can you tell me where you’ll be starting from and what time you can leave?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can leave from my place on Maple Street around 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can help coordinate the carpool. Who all needs a ride, and what time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’m checking the details now. I’ll get you the names and the time, then we can figure out the best pickup plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send me the details whenever you have them, and I’ll help sort out the pickup plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the carpool. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not much yet — I’m just checking who can take the early shift and who needs the later one. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the final plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, sounds good — just keep me posted, and I’ll do my best to fit whichever shift works.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Gus — any update on the carpool? I’m heading out on errands soon, so I’d love to know what the plan is.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira — I’m still waiting on a couple replies, but I’ll let you know as soon as the carpool’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for your update before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can pick up the kids at 8:10 and drop them off after school. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that still works for me — thank you!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to check the timing and who’s picking up whom first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia — can you check the timing and let me know who’s picking up whom?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll check the timing and sort out the pickup order, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m putting together the carpool—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, save me a spot — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down. I’ll send the pickup time soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do the afternoon pickup this week if that helps—what time does school let out on your side?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a huge help—school lets out at 3:15 on my side. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I can swing by around 3:15 then. Just text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m putting the carpool list together now. If you’re available, just tell me which days and I’ll slot you in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — which days work best for you this week?
